abilities.name: Ashes of the UED
abilities.text: During Army Building, you may include Units with the Terran Faction Tag and both Ground and Mechanical Combat Tags in your army. Those Units gain the Infested Combat Tag. Treat any CP cost for those Units' Special Abilities as BM. These Units cannot gain the BURROWED Status. (In this app: pick the Infested Goliath and Infested Siege Tank.)

abilities.name: Infestation
abilities.text: During Army Building, select exactly one Virus Card and add it to your Army List, paying its listed cost (if any).

abilities.name: Hostile Incubation
abilities.text: If there is no Friendly Infested Missile Turret on the battlefield, set a Friendly Infested Missile Turret Unit anywhere on the GROUND LEVEL of the battlefield more than 10″ away from any Enemy model. This Round, the Missile Turret is not eligible to use its Special Abilities (excluding Structure).
